message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to your account’s task data directly.  
Here’s how you can quickly see whether you’ve been given any tasks:

| Where to Look | What You’ll See |
|---------------|----------------|
| **Webex Teams/Collaboration App** – *Tasks* tab | A list of all tasks assigned to you across teams and projects. Each entry shows status (“Not started”, “In progress”, “Completed”), due dates, and who created it. |
| **Meetings & Events** – *Agenda* section | Any items marked as “Task” when someone assigns one during the meeting. These appear under the agenda item title and show assignee(s) and deadline. |
| **Email Notifications** | When a task is assigned, you receive an email summarizing the assignment—check your inbox or spam folder. |

### Quick steps inside the web client

1. Log into <https://web.webex.com> (or open the desktop/mobile app).  
2. Click the **“Tasks”** icon on the left‑hand navigation pane.  
3. Filter by **Assignee → Me** to view only tasks addressed to you.  

### Using the REST API (if you’re a developer)

```http
GET https://api.ciscospark.com/v1/tasks?assignees=me&status=open
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN
```

This returns JSON containing each pending task, its description, due date, and creator information.

---

Let me know if you’d like more detailed instructions for a particular device or integration!
